item.text: The campaign is ready with three approved posts testing the first-pull-up story, the free-trial offer, and level progressions. Their lifetime caps total $550, and all end at midnight after August 7 Eastern. X’s available device filter is iOS; that excludes Android and desktop, but doesn’t let me distinguish iPhones from iPads.

The first check shows $35.50 spent and 16 link clicks. That’s still a small sample, so I’m keeping the three posts running until the next check before shifting budget. Trial starts remain unobservable in X.

Day one delivered 58 link clicks for $127.31. The free-trial post has the lowest cost per click at $1.88, versus $2.76 for the level-progressions post, so I’ve shifted $37 of the remaining allocation toward it. The total cap stays at $550.
At midday on day two, spend is $174.59 for 79 link clicks. The free-trial post still leads on cost per click; I’m keeping the current allocation while more data comes in.

After two days, spend is $258.34 for 112 link clicks. I’ve paused the level-progressions post: its $2.92 cost per click trails the free-trial post’s $2.03. I’ve moved more budget to the free-trial post and kept the first-pull-up post running.

Midday on day three: $302.30 spent and 131 link clicks. The paused post’s spend has settled, so I’ve reassigned another $17 of its unused allocation to the free-trial post, keeping the combined caps at $550.

Entering the final day, spend is $395.20 for 170 link clicks. I’ve raised the free-trial post’s daily allowance so it can use its remaining allocation before tonight’s deadline; its lifetime cap is unchanged.

At noon Eastern on the final day, the campaign has spent $430.61 and delivered 184 link clicks. Both remaining posts are serving, with the free-trial post still ahead on cost per click. I’ll check again this evening and verify the midnight stop.

The evening check shows $481.25 spent and 205 link clicks. The campaign remains within budget and is scheduled to stop at midnight Eastern. I’m leaving the current allocation in place for the final hours.
The campaign has ended and is confirmed paused. X currently reports $536.64 spent, 491,850 impressions, and 224 link clicks. I’m allowing one more reporting update before the recap.

The August 4–7 campaign is complete and paused. Latest X reporting:

- Spend: **$542.63** of $550
- Impressions: **498,884**
- Link clicks: **226**
- Cost per link click: **$2.40**

I monitored all four days and shifted budget toward the free-trial post, which led on click efficiency. Delivery targeted US/Canada on iOS.

Figures may settle further as X finishes reporting. Trial starts must be checked against your own tracking.
